title: The Verb 'To Be'
subtitle: I am, thou art, he is — irregular as ever.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: I am, thou art, he is, we been/are, ye been, they been. Past: I was, thou were, he was, we were. Irregular, essential. The forms 'been' and 'are' compete in the plural; Chaucer uses both.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand The Verb 'To Be'.
